title: Environmental Education Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is developing a project with the Municipality of São Paulo through the Secretariat of Green and Environment (Secretaria Municipal do Verde e Meio Ambiente - SVMA) that includes the revision of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan and the elaboration of the Municipal Sanitation Plan. To properly implement this project, an Environmental Education Consultant is required to work directly on the phases 3 (Study of Solutions) and 4 (Action and Goals Plan), to ensure adequate planning considering the current situation and future forecast for the city of São Paulo. These stages involve defining and proposing possible solutions to the problems and bottlenecks identified in the diagnostic phase, as well as developing the Action and Goals Plan, both consolidated in Product 3.8.1, the "Final Study of Solutions, Action and Goals Plan" of the Integrated Solid Waste Management Plan. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Environmental Education Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities. Based on the diagnosis prepared regarding solid waste management in the municipality of São Paulo, the consultant will develop the following topics, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze the municipal solid waste management diagnosis, identifying key issues, challenges, threats, and bottlenecks that hinder progress in management and the implementation of sustainable solutions; b) Identify and define priority axes for the development of educational, socio-environmental, and sustainability-oriented solutions; c) Prepare preliminary proposals for programs, projects, educational approaches, communication strategies, and pedagogical materials aligned with the defined priority axes; d) Establish technical criteria and reference parameters to guide the formulation of contracts, investment plans, service targets, and educational initiatives related to solid waste management; e) Contribute to the analysis of cost structures and financing models for educational actions linked to urban cleaning and solid waste management services, in coordination with the Public Finance Consultant; f) Assess and describe educational solutions, detailing their application across the territory and within the municipal governance structure, considering different target audiences (residents, schools, large generators, communities, cooperatives, etc.); g) Interact directly with the consultants from stages 3 and 4 to ensure the effective application of the solutions identified for the formulation of actions and goals aimed at improving environmental education in the management of urban solid waste; h) Develop additional activities related to environmental education and solid waste management that may be identified by the project coordinator. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Environmental Education Consultant shall assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Work Plan. Description: The Work Plan must contain (at a minimum): (i) Detailed scope of the deliverable products, focusing on the stages, methodologies, and related activities required to conduct the study on environmental education for solid waste management; (ii) Details of the information, documents, and data required to support the technical analysis and development of solutions; (iii) Schedule of activities and delivery dates for each phase of the consultancy; (iv) Description of the flow of review, technical validation, and approval of the products; (v) Identification of key municipal institutions, programs, and actors relevant to the environmental education agenda in solid waste management and the strategy for institutional articulation during the consultancy. Expected delivery date: 15 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management. Description: The Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management must contain: Part 1: Study of Solution (i) Analysis of the complete diagnosis of municipal solid waste management, with emphasis on the environmental education component; (ii) Identification of key issues, structural bottlenecks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement within the current system; (iii) Critical review of institutional arrangements, existing programs, and communication practices related to waste management education; (iv) Identification and definition of priority axes for the development of sustainable and effective educational strategies within the solid waste sector; (v) Consideration of behavioral, social, environmental, territorial, and operational factors that influence educational outreach and citizen engagement; (vi) Assessment of national and international good practices, pedagogical models, and educational frameworks related to waste management and analysis of the relevance, adaptability, and applicability of these practices to the context of São Paulo; (vii) Preparation of preliminary proposals based on the defined priority axes; (viii) Development of programs, projects, pedagogical approaches, training models, thematic campaigns, communication materials, and tools tailored to different target audiences (e.g., residents, schools, cooperatives, large generators, communities); (ix) Determination of initial technical criteria, requirements, and institutional conditions necessary for the implementation of the proposed solutions; (x) Identification of intersectoral interfaces with municipal policies and institutions (e.g., PGIRS, PMEA 2024–2034, UMAPAZ Work Plan, SELIMP, SP Regula, SMSUB); (xi) Consolidation and detailing of the proposed solutions and definition of how they should be operationalized within the municipality of São Paulo; (xii) Specification of responsible institutions, required resources, key implementation steps, and enabling conditions. Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

title: Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Sênior
description:
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TaxEY

Oportunidade disponível para atuação em modelo híbrido no escritório de Botafogo.

#hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa sênior de tributos,  você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Orientar a equipe na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Direcionar o trabalho de campo, gerenciar o desempenho da equipe e manter a liderança atualizada sobre os trabalhos, documentando as áreas de maior risco;
  • Desenvolver constantemente a sua compreensão das tendências e processos atuais do mercado e compartilhar o seu conhecimento para desenvolver a equipe;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory;
  • Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos.

 Por que você?

 Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: 

  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro resumindo) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Graduação em Administração, Direito ou Contabilidade.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos: 

  • Excel - intermedirário/avançado;
  • Inglês – nível intermediário.

Quem somos  

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

title: Technician, Terminal Management Center 1
description:
Technician, Terminal Management Center


ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

SES is a Distribution Partner (DP) of Eutelsat OneWeb.  As a DP, the team member will be expected to assist in supporting SES customers utilizing Low Earth Orbit (LEO) terminals that operate on the OneWeb network and escalate issues to OneWeb as needed.  When required, this individual will need to schedule and facilitate troubleshooting calls between SES customers, OneWeb, and vendors.

The NOC Technician role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment responding to emails and answering phone calls to support OneWeb product offerings. The ideal candidate will be familiar with the demands and expectations of working in an operations center and is knowledgeable of radio frequency (RF) technology.

This team member will manage and maintain incoming customer requests and work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met. The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portugese, English and Spanish
  • Able to successfully learn and understand web based applications and tools for use in managing customer accounts. This will include navigation of OneWeb's portal (Device Hub) that is utilized extensively when troubleshooting performance issues with User Terminals (UTs).
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue
  • Ensure compliance with Intelsat standards practices and processes
  • Incorporate and leverage industry best practices while maintaining alignment with Intelsat goals and capabilities
  • Must be able to maintain customer privacy in compliance with all applicable laws
  • Manage positive relationships with customers to ensure customer retention
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be able to meet set expectations for call center metrics and customer turnaround times
  • Escalate customer reported technical service issues or requests to the appropriate NOC vertical team
  • Maintain accurate information and data in appropriate systems by tracking and capturing information and data

COMPETENCIES

  • Flexible and adaptive to change
  • Ability to operate in a team environment cross functionally where employees constantly provide support to each other
  • Customer communications – serves as the primary liaison for SES OneWeb customers, ensuring clear, professional, and proactive communications
  • Language skills – Provides multilingual support in Portuguese, English, and Spanish
  • Technical acumen – Demonstrates strong understanding of RF technology, satellite communications, network operations tools, and troubleshooting ability
  • Team collaboration – Works closely with multiple NOC technical verticals, vendors and customers to coordinate support efforts

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish
  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • 2 - 4 years of satellite communications experience including an understanding of RF technology
  • 1 - 2 years proven customer service including relevant experience or equivalent education experience
  • High aptitude for Networking and troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Possess problem analysis and problem resolution skills
  • Ability to successfully navigate and use Microsoft Office Suite products
  • Must be available to work rotating shifts providing 24x7x365 coverage

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • Experience working with Network Operation Centers is a plus
  • Networking experience (CCNA, COMP TIA NET+, etc.) preferred
